'''Droppit''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Bubbit]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
''"Droppit prefers peace. When things start feeling too chaotic, a cloud of mist gets released as a gentle hint. A polite, roundabout way of telling the noisy crowd to please, kindly, move along."''

Droppit is a purple rarity Tatari. Its name comes from “water drop” and “drop it”.

==Appearance==
A small, round, blue and white slug-like creature with rabbit-like ears that have orange circle markings. It has beady, black eyes and a small fancy bowtie.

Droppit's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with orange, and orange with green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Droppit's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Bubbit]] you need to complete the following task:
* Obtain Droppit x1 to have a bunny party!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "A Droppit and [[Gibber]] had a race. Droppit can only wriggle on land, which of course led to defeat."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/2026, its bio description said: "Droppit is fond of damp weather and dwells in wet places untouched by sunlight. Actively approaches those who are kind."
